Rafael Mariano Grossi, IAEA Director General met with HE Dr. Boubacar Kane, Ambassador and Head of Delegation, and Mr. Ishag Mohamed Moussa, President of the Autorité Nationale de Radioprotection de Sureté et de Sécurité Nucleaire, during a bilateral meeting at the IAEA 68th General Conference held at the Agency headquarters in Vienna, Austria. 19 September 2024.
